identityScope: Three catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current US Roborock pages. Catalog prices of 1,800, about 700 and 800 USD are replaced by the reviewed 799.99, 699.99 and 469.99 USD figures. The S8 MaxV Ultra published robot mass of 32.19 lbs conflicts with the catalog 4.2 kg and stays visible. The F25 Ultra page publishes only a gross weight and no robot mass. No new model was created and no company focus was added.

companyFocus.role: Consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer
companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch165. Roborock pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. Saros 10, Qrevo Edge, Qrevo Slim and Saros 10R are four separate current models. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions. All USPs, complete portfolios and leadership remain unproven.
highlights: Roborock is a consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer whose reviewed US range includes the Saros 10, Saros 10R, Qrevo Edge and Qrevo Slim.
The reviewed pages publish 11,000 Pa suction for the Qrevo Slim, 18,500 Pa for the Qrevo Edge and 22,000 Pa for the Saros 10, with HyperForce and dual anti-tangle brush systems.
Battery capacity is 5,200 mAh for the Qrevo Slim and 6,400 mAh for the Saros 10, Qrevo Edge and Saros 10R; the Saros 10 and Saros 10R pages cite 2.5-hour fast charging.
The Saros 10 page publishes 52 dB(A) in quiet mopping and 72 dB(A) dock self-emptying, and the Qrevo Edge page 55 dB mopping with 75 C mop washing.
The reviewed pages publish no full-charge runtime, payload or IP rating; robot mass figures of 8.6, 9.04 and 36.38 lbs remain separate from the catalog values.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: S8 MaxV Ultra, Qrevo MaxV and F25 Ultra are three separate current Roborock models. The S8 MaxV Ultra and Qrevo MaxV are floor robots; the F25 Ultra is a wet and dry stick vacuum, not a robot vacuum row.
body-scope-check.priceScopes: The reviewed US pages publish a 799.99 USD sale price against a 1,799.99 USD list for the S8 MaxV Ultra, 699.99 USD against 1,399.99 USD for the Qrevo MaxV and 469.99 USD against 699.99 USD for the F25 Ultra. The catalog values of 1,800, about 700 and 800 USD are not the current published prices.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: The S8 MaxV Ultra page publishes 32.19 lbs robot weight, which conflicts with the catalog 4.2 kg. The Qrevo MaxV page publishes 27.14 lbs, and the catalog has no value. The F25 Ultra page publishes only a 21.38 +/- 0.66 lbs gross weight, so no robot mass is recorded and the catalog empty value stays empty.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: The S8 MaxV Ultra page publishes 13.8 x 13.9 x 4.06 in robot dimensions with a separate 16.1 x 16.5 x 18.5 in dock. The Qrevo MaxV page publishes 13.78 x 13.9 x 4.01 in with a separate 13.38 x 19.17 x 20.51 in dock. The F25 Ultra page publishes 10.43 x 9.69 x 43.15 in product size for the wet and dry vacuum.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: No reviewed page publishes a payload rating; these are cleaning appliances without a manipulator or load rating.
body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: The S8 MaxV Ultra page publishes 5,200 mAh and the Qrevo MaxV page 5,200 mAh, both without a full-charge runtime in minutes. The F25 Ultra page publishes no battery capacity or runtime in minutes and only a gross weight. Suction is 10,000 Pa for the S8 MaxV Ultra, 7,000 Pa for the Qrevo MaxV and 22,000 Pa for the F25 Ultra.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: Roborock describes Reactive AI 2.0, VibraRise 3.0, DirTect, FlexiArm and intelligent voice assistance. These are manufacturer descriptions, not independent safety certification or proof of unsupervised operation.
body-scope-check.listingScopes: The roboticsdir and buyandrentrobots listings name products and companies; they do not establish prices, current stock, delivered fleets or independent performance.
